items.title: technique-row-obscured
items.claim: In Image #6, the bottom fade darkens the visible Back Kick row while the preceding technique rows remain clearly readable.
items.reason: The presentation obscures information the player is trying to learn.
items.suggest: Remove the gradient over the technique text and place a separate 'Scroll for more techniques' cue outside the scrolling list.

items.title: duplicate-control-headings
items.claim: In Image #3, both 'STANCE' and 'TECHNIQUE' appear twice: above the directional instructions and beneath their respective sticks.
items.reason: Repeated headings consume space without adding guidance.
items.suggest: Consolidate each stick's name and directional instructions into one legend, preserving readable text sizes.

items.title: player-side-unidentified
items.claim: In Image #3, the HUD names Asmongold and HasanAbi but does not visibly identify which fighter the player controls.
items.reason: A first-time player must connect the controls to a fighter without an explicit assignment.
items.suggest: Add a persistent 'You' label to the player-controlled fighter's nameplate.

items.title: countdown-without-opt-out
items.claim: In Image #18, the result screen displays 'REMATCH' and 'STARTING IN 8' without a visible control to decline that advertised countdown.
items.reason: A player who wants to study the result cannot see how to remain on that screen.
items.suggest: Add a 'Stay on results' button that cancels the countdown, alongside the existing rematch action.

items.title: round-clock-meaning-unverified
items.claim: Image #18 shows 29s on the HUD and 'FASTEST ROUND 6.4S' in the result summary, but the still cannot establish whether these readouts use the same clock.
items.reason: The player cannot tell whether round duration includes introductions, referee calls, or other pauses; this is not evidence that either value is incorrect.
items.suggest: Compare timestamped bout boundaries, simulation ticks, and referee pauses, then label the record explicitly as 'Active fight time' or 'Total round time' according to the verified calculation.
